dataHooks.name: Default active status
dataHooks.description: FI-01: Set status ACTIVE on new financial items.

dataHooks.name: Derive balance sheet role on create
dataHooks.description: FI-02: Map itemType to balanceSheetRole via switch (debt → LIABILITY, investment → ASSET, default NONE).

dataHooks.name: Derive balance sheet role on type change
dataHooks.description: FI-02: Re-apply balanceSheetRole when itemType changes (same switch as create).

dataHooks.name: Create initial schedule row
dataHooks.description: FI-03/FI-04: Seed paymentSchedule horizon from scheduleHorizonMonths (frequency-aware due dates).

dataHooks.name: Mark schedule PAID
dataHooks.description: TX-01: When a transaction links paymentScheduleId, mark that schedule PAID.

dataHooks.name: Update item balance on payment
dataHooks.description: TX-03: Decrease financialItem.currentBalance when type is PAYMENT.

dataHooks.name: Update account on income
dataHooks.description: Increase account.currentBalance for INCOME transactions.

dataHooks.name: Update account on expense
dataHooks.description: Decrease account.currentBalance for EXPENSE transactions.

dataHooks.name: Update account on payment
dataHooks.description: Decrease account.currentBalance for PAYMENT transactions.

dataHooks.name: Update accounts on transfer
dataHooks.description: TX-04: Debit accountId and credit toAccountId for TRANSFER transactions.

dataHooks.name: Advance next due date
dataHooks.description: TX-02: After payment, set financialItem.nextDueDate to earliest remaining UPCOMING schedule dueDate.

dataHooks.name: Complete one-time item on payment
dataHooks.description: FI-07: When paying a ONE_TIME item, mark financialItem COMPLETED.

dataHooks.name: Sync item balance from snapshot
dataHooks.description: BS-01: Copy balanceSnapshot.balance to financialItem.currentBalance.

dataHooks.name: Regenerate schedules on item update
dataHooks.description: FI-05: Delete UPCOMING paymentSchedule rows when schedule fields change.

dataHooks.name: Recreate schedule on item update
dataHooks.description: FI-05/FI-04: Recreate paymentSchedule horizon after schedule fields change (pairs with delete hook).

dataHooks.name: Skip upcoming on pause or close
dataHooks.description: FI-06: Mark UPCOMING paymentSchedule rows SKIPPED when item is PAUSED or CLOSED.

dataHooks.name: Extend schedule horizon
dataHooks.description: FI-04: Monthly queued extension — top up paymentSchedule rows toward scheduleHorizonMonths.

dataHooks.name: Roll forward next schedule
dataHooks.description: PS-01: After a schedule row is PAID, create the next UPCOMING row (skipped for ONE_TIME and IRREGULAR items; frequency-aware date step).

dataHooks.name: Generate flat loan plan
dataHooks.description: LD-01: Flat monthly plan (static payment/principal/interest per row — not declining-balance amortization).

dataHooks.name: Regenerate flat loan plan
dataHooks.description: LD-02: Replace UPCOMING schedule rows when loan terms change (flat plan, not true amortization).

dataHooks.name: Mark overdue schedules
dataHooks.description: PS-02: Daily sweep — UPCOMING rows with dueDate before today become OVERDUE.

dataHooks.name: Cascade delete related records
dataHooks.description: EX-02: Remove paymentSchedule, loanDetails, and balanceSnapshot rows when a financialItem is deleted.

dataHooks.name: Set income payDay from parent
dataHooks.description: EX-01: Derive payDay from parent financialItem nextDueDate.

dataHooks.name: Set service billingDay from parent
dataHooks.description: EX-01: Derive billingDay from parent financialItem nextDueDate.
